column1: # Sender and subject rules that decide which messages need action.
# Applied to the whole database by imc_tag_apply.sh, so a change here is
# always re-applied to past mail as well. Compare before and after; do not
# judge a rule by reading it.
# Columns are tab separated:
#   tag     the notmuch tag to add. Tags listed here are owned by this file:
#           imc_tag_apply.sh removes them from every message before it
#           re-adds them, so deleting a line really does undo it. Tags that
#           do not appear in this file (done, later, ...) are never touched.
#   field   from, subject, or to
#   regex   case insensitive extended regular expression, matched with ~
#   comment why this rule exists. Future you will ask.
# THIS FILE IS COMMITTED TO GIT. A "from" rule naming your real bank records
# which bank you use. The subject rules below are generic and safe to commit;
# the sender rules are left as commented placeholders on purpose. Decide for
# yourself whether to put real domains here or to keep this file untracked.
# Sender rules are the reliable path: a bank that changes its subject lines
# still matches on its domain. Fill these in before trusting this system.
